<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">

    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#455154"/>
      <stop offset=".45" stop-color="#E6436D"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FF5E00"/>

    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#4E4F57"/>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#161722"/>

  <!-- full-screen video background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  </g>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <text x="18" y="680" font-family="Proxima Nova, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">@maya.chen</text>
    <text x="18" y="706" font-family="Proxima Nova, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Golden hour walks hit different ✨</text>

  <text x="195" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">+</text>
  <text x="284" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#86878B">Inbox</text>
  <text x="356" y="837" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Proxima Nova, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#86878B">Profile</text>
